The '''Tosste system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tosste/Legends|Tosste]]. The Tosste system was surrounded by dust clouds.<ref name="TEA" />
